rollback_evidence: G80 (XE-M027), measured on IOL XE 17.18.2 (router) in the GNS3 lab, task netops-20261117-454. Keys: Loopback<n> and Ethernet subinterfaces <port>.<n>; an SVI (interface Vlan<vid>) is refused by the measured router image and is not a key of this table, and physical ports keep the interface and vlan-membership tables. Create: 'interface KEY', 'vrf forwarding V' (create only, before the addresses), 'encapsulation dot1Q VID' (create only, required for a subinterface), 'description', 'shutdown', 'ip address A M' (/8 to /32), 'ipv6 address P/L'; update replaces the primary IPv4 address with 'ip address' or removes it with 'no ip address', and replaces the IPv6 address with 'no ipv6 address OLD' then 'ipv6 address NEW'; delete is 'no interface KEY' (a deleted subinterface stays as 'deleted' in show interfaces description and is absent from the running configuration). A subinterface has no own admin-state: the check account sees the state of the parent port (measured: Ethernet0/2.80 shows admin down under a shut Ethernet0/2), so admin-state of a subinterface is refused and its shutdown line is outside the profile. One IPv4 and one IPv6 address; secondary addresses, routing protocol and other interface lines are outside the profile and refused; a referenced interface (a route or protocol line names it) is not deleted. The safeguard is the revert timer of the interface profile. Refused before any write: the management interface and subinterfaces of it, an interface of a management VRF, an address overlapping another interface of the same VRF, the management subnet or the SSH client address. The check account (privilege 1) reads show interfaces description, show ip interface KEY, show ipv6 interface KEY and, for a subinterface, show interfaces KEY.
